label: early original-phase token right after z (t=3-5), in sequences starting with e
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase at steps 3-5 (71% of mass at t=3). Never fires at the delimiter or during copy. The main driver is the previous input being z (79% of mass, 27x lift). It is further boosted when the first original token is e (57% of mass, 16x lift; y and h less so), and when the current input is one of l, s, 1, a, u, w, g, f. The strongest activations are on exactly this conjunction, e.g. e 0 z [l]. The feature is conjunctive and graded, so no simple predicate covers it well. prev=z at t=3-5 alone gets recall 0.77 but precision 0.02. Adding the first-token and current-token conditions gets the best dev F1, about 0.40. Weaker activations occur without z, e.g. e 0 1 [a] or e e 0 b [u]. Most z-followed positions with other current tokens (b, k, m, c, 3) stay silent.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=e (+6.10), prev_tok=z (+4.60), t=3 & prev_tok=z (+3.21), orig0=y (+2.97), orig_idx=4 (+2.83), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=w (+2.54). Lower it: correct=1 (-7.15), orig_idx=-1 (-2.49).
